integrity: Explicit elementary proof plus finite checker; finite checks do not establish the general theorem or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary first-order sentences on unordered equal-size equivalence classes with independent fair unary colors; both class size and class number diverge. No ordered quotient or growing-rank formulas. Closest related 2025 conference chapter was accessible only as an abstract; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Poisson-window classification for first-order limits of randomly colored equivalence classes
